name: Canoness
patron:
Your Patron is a ranking commander amongst the Adepta Sororitas, a military master of the Adeptus Ministorum. She has authority over Sisters of Battle, though others often fall under her sway — Preachers, Crusaders, and Death Cult Assassins to name but a few.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.uT72W5ZHNDeLtGtM]{Purification Rituals}

name: Criminal Mastermind
patron:
Your Patron has thrived in the vicious criminal undergrounds of the @UUID[JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96]{Macharian Sector}, gaining significant power and resources and a desire for more.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.6JLGOSN04IfwkvZs]{Plausible Deniability}

name: Trader Militant
patron:
Your Patron is a Trader Militant, willing and even eager to exploit the military allowances within their warrant of trade to the fullest. They are a minor military force onto themselves, often overthrowing whole worlds to bring their populace — and their resources — into the Imperium.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.oXyZ2hmINFVN3EPT]{Voidship}

name: Ordo Xenos Inquisitor
patron:
Your Patron is a servant of the Ordo Xenos, concerned with locating and purging inhuman taint wherever it is found. Many an Ork Waaagh! or Drukhari incursion has been averted by the subtle work of an Inquisitor and their acolytes. Some make use of xenos weaponry, turning the tools of their hated foes back upon them. Others view all technology conceived by inhuman minds as indelibly corrupt. Their successes are uncelebrated, while their failures have doomed billions.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.3M9o35qxoxiQRzP5]{Limitless Authority}

name: Guildmaster
patron:
Your Patron is the master of a guild, a form of trade organisation permitted on certain worlds as a means of controlling and directing labourers. Though their authority is typically very narrow, many Guildmasters are keen to expand their influence.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Sdrdzx7KmkZiuh0B]{Registered Trader}

name: Lord-Commissar
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking member of the Commissariat, a political officer of such legendary stature and achievement that they have risen to a powerful position, responsible for ensuring morale is maintained at the highest levels. This includes watching for corruption, incompetence, and outright heresy among the officers of the regiment.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.E6PjpL6Ysup9g9AJ]{Fearsome Reputation}

name: Arch-Confessor
patron:
Your Patron is a zealous priest of the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.PdQjDIH5C6kx3vAy]{Adeptus Ministorum}, an exemplar of fervent faith in the Emperor. They are dedicated to uncovering any trace of heresy that lurks within the Imperium, and may have authority over the citizens of a single hive, a whole world, or even an entire subsector.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.iyNmjADrdcSql6jM]{Ecclesiarchal Shrine}

name: Port Commander
patron:
Your Patron is the sovereign ruler of a voidport, the absolute authority of an invaluable transport hub of the Macharian Sector. They may be responsible for a planetside spaceport or a stellar void station, but in either case their word is law. A Port Commander is wholly responsible for their voidport, and is invested with the power to gather information and search or even detain ships in pursuit of the Emperor's enemies.

Merchant Fleet ports are most concerned with assessing and transporting goods while offering voidships a chance to refuel, whereas Navis Imperialis ports are focused defensive positions or staging areas for bitter conflict.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.tct4xpbh6d7XaL6X]{Voidport Peerage}

name: Diplomat
patron:
Your Patron is a Rogue Trader devoted to negotiating with societies within and beyond the Imperium, bridging the gaps between Factions (and even Species in rare circumstances) in the name of profit.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.oXyZ2hmINFVN3EPT]{Voidship}

name: Magos Biologis
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking Tech-Priest, an experienced master Genetor specialising in the study and manipulation of biological life.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Tg0tXahB0KNtPyLV]{Ameliorator}

name: Forge Lord
patron:
Your Patron is an Artisan Magos, capable of maintaining ancient technology and overseeing the production of Omnissiah-approved patterns.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.opCfLwJw2T80Nsdq]{Manufactorum Master}

name: Ordo Hereticus Inquisitor
patron:
Your Patron serves the Ordo Hereticus, rooting out heresy in all its form. Rogue Psykers, heretical preachers, and secretive cultists have all met a grisly end at the hands of an Ordo Hereticus Inquisitor. For every traitor they have uncovered, however, a dozen more worm their way ever closer to the heart of the Imperium.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.3M9o35qxoxiQRzP5]{Limitless Authority}

name: Voidship Captain
patron:
Your Patron is the commander of a voidship and its innumerable crew, the ruler of a vessel that can travel between worlds. They may be a Chartist Captain, transferring titanic cargoes of crucial resources, or they may be part of the Navis Imperialis, ferrying troopers to war zones whilst wielding titanic arsenals capable of scorching whole worlds.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.oXyZ2hmINFVN3EPT]{Voidship}

name: Sister of Silence
patron:
Your Patron is a Knight-Centura, a Sister of Silence, a ranking member of an ancient order cursed with the Pariah gene and sworn to silence. She may accompany or even command a Black Ship, hunting psykers throughout the Imperium, or otherwise protect the Imperium from Psychic threats.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.ZQVEe1jI680zL964]{Null Sanctum}

Sworn To Silence

Full Sisters of Silence never speak aloud, and often communicate through a complex system of sign language known as Thoughtmark, though a streamlined language known as Battlemark is used to relay crucial information quickly during combat. A Sister of Silence will typically retain a Sister-in-waiting to translate this secret language for the characters, though one of the players may wish to play a Sister-in-waiting themselves to perform this function.

name: Astropath
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking Astropath, perhaps the Head of an Astropathic Choir, soul-bound to the Emperor of Mankind. Their duty is to communicate across the void of space via the tumultuous warp, projecting images into another Astropath’s mind and interpreting the response in kind.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.niqxBVj5cdI03Woj]{Astropathic Communication}

name: Senior Officer
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking executive officer of the Astra Militarum, assuming command of an entire regiment of troops and war machines.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.jVqhxWe0o7nWz3Qj]{Seconded Troopers}

name: Departmento Munitorum Ordinate
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking official of the Departmento Munitorum, the logistical sub-division of the Administratum responsible for ensuring the armies of the Astra Militarum are raised, armed, and armoured, then liaising with the Navis Imperialis to ferry these warriors to the battlefield.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.L3kIcGE0xpebmNbA]{Munitorum Depot}

name: Tithe Prefectus
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking official of the @UUID[JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.KphmdOYxm3Xl9I4i]{Adeptus Administratum} tasked with ensuring the titanic tithes of the worlds of the @UUID[JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96]{Macharian Sector} are delivered and the Emperor is paid His due. The exact nature of the tithe varies from world to world, with some providing food or processed ores, while others provide desperately needed manufactured goods. Regardless of its form, the size of the tithe is always onerous, calculated to be nothing less than everything the planet can spare.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.YFMKd1NYhlAS5JK7]{Tithe Inspection}
